address: 28 rue du Pré-Étienne, Les Sables-d'Olonne, 85180, France
bio: In a residential area blissfully free of the seaside town’s throngs of tourists, this enjoyable eatery has a well-designed menu whose dishes star carefully selected ingredients: haddock and beetroot carpaccio; black pudding and Savora-flavoured hollandaise sauce; ballotine of free-range poultry, fried polenta and tomato caviar…...
